svg.title: Rampage actual UI mock — hit-team

text.tspan: CO-OP • CLIENT • Toast • 4/25 actors (0 AI) • 0 spectators
KEYS LIVE • WASD / arrows + SPACE • Esc releases
WASD / arrows: walk & climb • Space: punch • Esc: release • dodge marked lanes!
CO-OP: crew punches are safe. Climb 2, 4, 6; flatten towers, then boss.
SAMPLED / estimated • In ground range — punch! • HP loss, not fame • YOU: exact hit / TEAM: total
Joined as player: sampled team damage, no per-attacker network receipt. • Drag title to move • Close hides; Leave exits
BOSS RECOVERING • catch it on the ground • last sample
SAMPLE • 7 / 10 HP • EXPOSED • Hit near boss on ground
